summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated in-tarball payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e` identifier renaming and wrapper-object indirection) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the detected platform, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated `@bun-cjs` blob using rotating string-array indirection (function `WV8StW` shifts array `n7gIxM` over a 1000+ element lookup table) and is not human-readable. The package advertises itself as a Jest startup helper and its declared main `dist/index.js` is only 532 bytes — the Jest re-export purpose does not require an alternate language runtime. The result is that `npm install` of this package fetches a second runtime and executes obfuscated, opaque attacker-controlled bytes on the installer's host under a runtime that Node-focused scanners do not introspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
